# fallow-health

Fallow health score, grade, non-zero penalties and the functions over a line limit, in one run.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--cmd` | str | no | `bunx fallow` | Command that runs fallow |
| `--limit` | int | no | `60` | Line limit per function |
| `--top` | int | no | `10` | Most long functions to list |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run fallow-health
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys score, grade, penalties, long_count, long_functions.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/fallow-health.py` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
